Teaching is grounded in active, research-driven learning where students develop technical skills while investigating real environmental questions. My courses emphasize field experiences, quantitative analysis, geospatial technologies, scientific writing, and collaborative research that prepares students for graduate study and professional careers.


## Current Courses: Fall 2026

::: {.course-grid}

::: {.course-card}
::: {.course-number}
GEO 3210
:::

::: {.course-title}
Geomorphology
:::

::: {.course-meta}
Undergraduate • In Person
:::

This course focuses on the origin and development of landforms and landscapes on Earth’s surface, with a systematic analysis of the geomorphic processes that produce and modify them.

::: {.course-topics}
**Topics**

- Linear vs. Complex Systems Theory
- Geomorphic Models
- Applied Geomorphology
- Surface Processes & Landforms (Fluvial, Coastal, Glacial, etc.)
:::

::: {.course-actions}
[Course Website](courses/geo3210.qmd){.course-button}
:::

:::


::: {.course-card}
::: {.course-number}
GEO 3210L
:::

::: {.course-title}
Geomorphology Lab
:::

::: {.course-meta}
Undergraduate • In Person
:::

A hands-on laboratory course accompanying GEO 3210 that emphasizes field and laboratory investigations of geomorphic processes. Students apply quantitative analyses and geomorphic principles to interpret data and evaluate landform and landscape evolution.

::: {.course-topics}
**Topics**

- Geomorphic Modeling
- Sediment Transport Processes
- Landscape Evolution
- Topographic Surveying
- Field Report
:::

::: {.course-actions}
[Course Website](courses/geo3210L.qmd){.course-button}
:::

:::


::: {.course-card}
::: {.course-number}
GEO 6118
:::

::: {.course-title}
Research Design
:::

::: {.course-meta}
Graduate • Online
:::

An introduction to designing and conducting research in the environmental sciences using the scientific method. Students develop and complete an original research project from question formulation through data analysis and scientific communication.

::: {.course-topics}
**Topics**

- Literature Review
- Statistical Analysis
- Scientific Communication
- Collaborative Research
:::

::: {.course-actions}
[Course Website](courses/geo6118.qmd){.course-button}
:::

:::
:::
